canonical_name: Urban Sketchers Asheville (co-hosting the 2nd Annual Carolinas Sketch Crawl with Urban Sketchers Charlotte and Urban Sketchers Greenville)
summary: A weekend of sketch-crawl sessions, a guided architecture walk, workshops, and a closing drink-and-draw across Downtown Asheville and the River Arts District, June 5-7, 2026. It is the 2nd Annual Carolinas Sketch Crawl, organized jointly by artists from the Urban Sketchers Asheville, Charlotte, and Greenville chapters (recipients of an Urban Sketchers International Regional Events Grant), not a one-off commercial tour. Urban Sketchers is a global community of on-location sketching artists with standing local chapters, and this event is explicitly built around that returning membership rather than a rotating public audience.

evidence.note: Listings describe artists gathering at multiple venues to sketch, share, and learn together, tagged 'Urban Sketching' and 'All Skill Levels', across three consecutive days (a crawl format, not a single class).

WNCW reports the event is organized by artists from the Asheville, Charlotte, and Greenville Urban Sketchers (USk) chapters, an international movement of local sketching communities, and calls it the 2nd Annual edition.
AIA South Carolina's listing confirms the event is run under the Urban Sketchers (USk) banner with a guided architecture-sketch walk as part of the program.

A 2025 Carolinas Sketch Crawl listing (Forest City, NC) shows this is a recurring annual event that rotates location, consistent with a standing regional Urban Sketchers community rather than a single venue's promotion.
Facebook event page exists for the 2026 gathering, giving the group an ongoing public presence beyond the Mountain Xpress listing.
